args.message:
I added up order amounts for each city within each region, then took a simple average across the cities so each city counts once.

| Region | Average city revenue | Cities |
|---|---|---|
| North | 36,444.92 | 3 |
| South | 34,756.63 | 3 |
| East | 34,369.35 | 2 |
| West | 24,575.90 | 2 |
| No known region | 596.65 | 2 |

- **Oslo:** It appears in both North and South. I counted it once in each region, because cities are grouped within their region.
- **No known region:** This group has two buckets: Paris (677.83 from 10 orders) and 6 orders with no city (515.47). I counted the no-city orders as one city. If you'd rather leave them out, this group's average is just Paris at 677.83.
